training_population: Equal family probabilities: iid resampling, persistence, forward rotor; continuous Dirichlet(.7) initial/value prior and Uniform(.6,.98) strength. No family labels or parameter identities enter fit.
heldout_families: Reverse rotor and lag-two rotation never used for fitting, OOD cutoff or risk calibration; no threshold tuning from their outputs. Reverse is untrained first-order law, lag2 is untrained second-order law.
information: Same complete raw public training streams and generator grouping for both ordinary candidates. Same public 2/3/4-missing token prefixes, raw aliases, possible one indexed READ and actual fees.
selection: Per model .99 higher OOD surprise cutoff from independent ood generators. Four fixed thresholds: Bonferroni CP bounds at .05/(2 models*4 thresholds*2 risks), require overall and fractional risk <=.10 and >=20 fractional answers. Select maximum fractional accepted then lowest threshold; fallback near point mass with failed calibration gate.
confirmation: 4096 generator-cluster bootstrap replicates seed1905513 independently per panel. Report one-sided95% risk bound and two-sided95% payoff/Brier paired intervals. Zero accepted bootstrap denominator gives risk1. Empirical bootstrap does not guarantee finite-sample coverage.
gate: Each panel separately: no invalidity or support loss; frozen calibration passes; >=32 fractional accepted; upper95 fractional and overall error <=.10. An unseen-law gate requires BOTH heldout panels; never pool them into the primary panel.
negative_result: No post-confirmation threshold/model/sample repair. All outcomes and costs retained. Both references are finite ordinary models, not analytic HCSN D-B, real AV, semantic addressing, bounded streaming, GPU/energy or production qualification. Original four-stage gates unchanged.
